## Who is on the other side of the trade

The pack carries no crowding series for this name - the short-interest gap is declared, so who is pressing the price is unknown. What the record does carry: the shares trade two days stale (the market was shut at capture, disclosed in the record), and the last price of 123.45 is 18 percent below the 52-week high.

With no dated flow or crowding fact in the record, the structural read stays modest: nothing here says the price is being set by forced sellers or by euphoria. The record supports acting at quoted prices without structural edge either way.
